nodes.label: POST /mock/search-library - Mock SAP Search Library
nodes.rationale: Mock endpoint standing in for the SAP search-library feed. Accepts an untyped object body whose example is a full SAP PR/library payload (tipe_data, pr_number, im_number, material_group, pr_requestor_email, currency, price_item_idr, purchase_group), letting RFQ flows be exercised without a live SAP connection. Tagged Mock; bearer secured.

edges.source_location: requestBody example carries SAP PR fields that plausibly seed RFQ records, but no declared link
